item.title: Using a library
item.description: Practise asking library staff for help, finding a book, and checking when to bring it back. Learn how to ask where you can sit and read.

children.definition: An opening where you put books to give them back to the library.
children.example: I put the two books in the return slot by the door.
collocations: put a book in the return slot

children.definition: To take something that you can use for a short time and then give back.
children.example: Can I borrow this book for a week?

children.definition: A card that shows you are a member and can take books home.
children.example: Do I need a library card to take this book home?

children.definition: A flat, narrow surface where you put things like books.
children.example: The cookbooks are on the top shelf.

children.definition: The date by which you must return a library book.
children.example: The due date for my book is next Friday.

children.definition: A person who works in a library and helps people find and use books.
children.example: I asked the librarian where to find books about birds.

children.definition: The length of time you can keep a library book before you have to give it back.
children.example: The borrowing period for most of the library's cookbooks is three weeks.
children.translation_ru: срок, на который библиотека выдаёт книгу

children.definition: To get permission to keep a book for longer.
children.example: I haven't finished the book yet. Can I renew it?

children.definition: A list of the books a library has, with information about each one.
children.example: I searched the catalogue for a book about old trains.

children.definition: Ready for someone to use or take home now.
children.translation_ru: доступный для чтения в библиотеке или для выдачи на дом
children.translation_uz: hozir oʻqish yoki uyga olib ketish mumkin boʻlgan

children.definition: A part of the library where one kind of book is kept.
children.example: Which section has books for young children?

children.definition: A place in the library where people can sit with books or study.
children.example: I took my notes to the reading room to study.
Is there a quiet place where I can study?

children.definition: A place where staff answer questions and show you what to do.
children.example: Let's go to the help desk and ask how to use the printer.
